impact.label: Finance share archive (finance-share-archive.7z)
impact.notes: Uploaded to mega-sync-store.example before encryption began.

impact.label: HR records (hr-records.7z)
impact.notes: Occupational health and absence files. Art 9 data.

impact.label: Domain credential store (ntds-dump.7z)
impact.notes: Every domain hash. A tenant-wide password reset follows from this row alone.

impact.label: FS-01 and FS-02 file shares
impact.notes: Encrypted in place. Shadow copies deleted; restore is from offline backup only.

actions.task: Rebuild DC-01 and reset krbtgt twice
Confirm scope of data staged to mega-sync-store.example
Restore file shares from offline backup
Draft customer incident and breach-notification report

casenotes.note: Human-operated ransomware. Initial access via macro phish, escalation through svc-backup (domain admin), domain-wide spread by PsExec, double extortion before encryption. Backups reachable from a domain-admin account is the key gap.
casenotes.author: Demo Analyst

casenotes.note: Encryption reached 4 servers and 14 workstations before isolation. NTDS dumped, so assume full domain credential compromise and force a tenant-wide password reset.
casenotes.author: Demo Analyst

methods.name: Sentinel proxy sweep
methods.established: Exfiltration of three archives to an external sync host
methods.query:
CommonSecurityLog
| where TimeGenerated between (datetime(2026-08-13T16:00:00Z) .. datetime(2026-08-13T18:00:00Z))
| where DeviceAction == "allow" and SentBytes > 50000000
| where RequestURL has "mega-sync-store.example"
| summarize Sent = sum(SentBytes) by SourceIP, DestinationHostName

methods.name: PsExec lateral movement sweep
methods.established: Lateral movement to twelve workstations by PsExec
methods.query:
SecurityEvent
| where EventID == 7045
| where ServiceName startswith "PSEXESVC"
| summarize Started = min(TimeGenerated) by Computer
